# Sprout

> Sprout is a screen time app for iPhone and Android that blocks distracting apps once a daily allowance runs out, and gives minutes back only when you complete a real-world activity such as pushups, steps, reading, studying or chores. Not to be confused with Sprout Social or other products named Sprout.

- Website: https://the-sprout.app/
- iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sprout-screen-time-habits/id6762459172
- Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sprout.ds_labs

## What Sprout does

- Daily allowance: free minutes per day for the apps you choose (for example TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Snapchat or games). When they run out, those apps are blocked.
- Earn time back: pushups and squats counted with the phone camera, steps, and timed activities such as studying, deep work, walking, yoga, cooking, cleaning, laundry or meditation. Users can create custom activities.
- No free extra time: the block lifts because an activity was completed, not through a "one more minute" button.
- Reels and Shorts blocking on Android: blocks the short-video feed inside Instagram, YouTube and other apps while the rest of the app keeps working.
- For kids: a parent can set Sprout up on a child's phone and lock the settings with a PIN, so the child earns screen time with chores, homework, reading or exercise.
- Privacy: screen time data and app choices stay on the phone.
- Price: free to start. Premium adds more blocked apps and features and comes with a free trial.

## Who it fits

- People who keep overriding Screen Time or Digital Wellbeing limits.
- People who scroll at unpredictable times, where schedule-based blockers such as Opal do not help.
- Parents who want a "homework and chores first" screen time deal that the phone enforces.
